description: Data services layer: LocationService (geolocator+geocoding, JSON persistence), SearchQueryBuilder (label/keyword/location URL builder), CartRepository (JSON persistence, item CRUD), WishlistRepository (JSON persistence). All persist to getApplicationDocumentsDirectory(). Independent of FEAT-001 only for LocationData which is defined in GeoFilter — import it from there. Depends on FEAT-001 (geo_filter.dart defines LocationData).
steps: Create lib/core/services/location_service.dart. Import geolocator, geocoding, path_provider, dart:convert, dart:io. Re-export LocationData from geo_filter.dart (or duplicate — prefer importing from geo_filter). LocationData: final String lat, lon, pin, city, state, country; const constructor; fromJson factory; toJson method; copyWith. LocationService class: Future<LocationData?> getCurrentLocation() — Geolocator.requestPermission(), Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(desiredAccuracy: LocationAccuracy.high), then placemarkFromCoordinates to get Placemark, build LocationData from placemark.postalCode, .locality, .administrativeArea, .country, lat/lon. Future<void> saveLocation(LocationData loc) — write JSON to documentsDir/antinna_location.json. Future<LocationData?> loadLocation() — read file, fromJson. Future<List<LocationData>> searchLocation(String query) — locationFromAddress(query) -> List<Location>, then placemarkFromCoordinates for each, build LocationData list (limit to 5 results).

Create lib/core/services/search_query_builder.dart. Class SearchQueryBuilder: static String build({List<String> keywords = const [], List<String> labels = const [], LocationData? location}) — join keywords with space, join labels with space (each label: item is a 'label:X' term if it doesn't already start with 'label:'), if location != null append 'postalCode:${location.pin}' or 'addressLocality:${location.city}' (whichever is non-empty), join all parts with ' '. Static String buildFeedUrl({required String blogId, List<String> labels = const [], List<String> keywords = const [], LocationData? location, int maxResults = 20, int startIndex = 1}) — base 'https://www.blogger.com/feeds/$blogId/posts/default'; if labels non-empty append '/-/'+labels.join('/'); build Uri with queryParameters {alt:'json', max-results: maxResults.toString(), start-index: startIndex.toString()} plus q param if keywords or location non-empty.

Create lib/core/cart/cart_models.dart. CartAddon: final String name; final double price; final int qty; fromJson/toJson. OrderItem: final String postId, postUrl, name, imageUrl; final double price; final String priceCurrency; final int qty; final String? variantId, packageId; final List<CartAddon> addons; fromJson/toJson; copyWith. CartOrder: final List<OrderItem> items; final String priceCurrency; fromJson/toJson; double get totalPrice; factory CartOrder.empty() => CartOrder(items: [], priceCurrency: 'INR'); // TODO: Drift table integration.

Create lib/core/cart/cart_repository.dart. Import path_provider, dart:convert, dart:io, cart_models.dart. CartRepository: Future<CartOrder> load() — read documentsDir/antinna_cart.json, CartOrder.fromJson; returns CartOrder.empty() if file absent. Future<void> _save(CartOrder order) — write JSON. Future<CartOrder> addItem(OrderItem item) — load, if item with same postId+variantId exists increment qty+merge addons, else append; save; return updated. Future<CartOrder> removeItem(String postId, {String? variantId}) — load, filter out matching item, save, return updated. Future<CartOrder> updateQty(String postId, int qty, {String? variantId}) — load, find item, set qty (remove if qty<=0), save, return updated. Future<CartOrder> clear() — save empty order, return it.

Create lib/core/wishlist/wishlist_repository.dart. Import path_provider, dart:convert, dart:io. WishlistRepository: Future<List<String>> _load() — read documentsDir/antinna_wishlist.json as List<String> postIds; returns [] if absent. Future<void> _save(List<String> ids). Future<List<String>> add(String postId) — load, add if not present, save, return. Future<List<String>> remove(String postId) — load, remove, save, return. Future<bool> contains(String postId) — load, return ids.contains(postId).
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze exits 0 after these files are added
SearchQueryBuilder.build(labels: ['electronics', 'phones']) produces a non-empty query string containing 'electronics' and 'phones'
findings: Files created: lib/core/services/location_service.dart (LocationService with getCurrentLocation/saveLocation/loadLocation/searchLocation, re-exports LocationData from geo_filter.dart), lib/core/services/search_query_builder.dart (SearchQueryBuilder with build/buildFeedUrl static methods), lib/core/cart/cart_models.dart (CartAddon, OrderItem, CartOrder with totalPrice getter and CartOrder.empty()), lib/core/cart/cart_repository.dart (CartRepository with load/addItem/removeItem/updateQty/clear, JSON-persisted to antinna_cart.json), lib/core/wishlist/wishlist_repository.dart (WishlistRepository with add/remove/contains, JSON-persisted to antinna_wishlist.json). LocationData is imported from geo_filter.dart (not duplicated). flutter analyze exits 0 with no errors.
